rules: Use explicit Arabic web fonts from Google Fonts: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap');
No 'Inter' or generic sans for headings.
Headings max scale: text-4xl to text-6xl (clamp fluidly).
RTL (Right-to-Left) is MANDATORY. Ensure <html dir='rtl'> and Tailwind RTL features (start/end instead of left/right) are used.

strategy: Use Pale Background (#F4F7FC) for app background.
Use Primary Navy (#071D32) for text, heavy headings, footers, and solid structural blocks.
Use Primary Blue (#2563EB) strictly for primary actions, CTAs, and active states.
Tint neutral grays slightly with blue to match the navy.

surfaces: Marketing: Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40) for sticky headers over backgrounds.
Dashboards: Flat solid surfaces, subtle 1px border (border-[#071D32]/10), soft shadow on hover.
No full transparent backgrounds under text. Use glass or solid blocks.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. Soft diffuse shadows for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp inner borders for structural clarity. Nested radii (child <= parent).

layouts.marketing: Asymmetric Bento Grids. Large hero sections. Generous spacing (p-12 to p-24).
layouts.dashboards: High-density grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), tight gaps (gap-4). Cardless or very subtle 1px border cards.
layouts.spacing: 2-3x more spacing than typical templates. Use p-8 instead of p-4.
layouts.alignment: RTL-first. Align right by default for paragraphs and labels. Ensure icons are on the logical start (right) side of text.

rules: Micro-animations on ALL interactive elements (hover states, click/press).
Use specific transitions (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease), NOT 'transition: all'.
Staggered entrance animations for lists and bento grids.
Hover state color must be lighter hue of active state.

libraries: Shadcn/UI for dashboard/admin panels (tables, dropdowns, dialogs). heavily customized to match brand.
lucide-react for icons (ensure RTL mirroring if direction matters).
rules: Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons (rounded-lg).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type="date">. Use Shadcn equivalents.
All text must meet minimum 4.5:1 contrast.
Explicitly set text color on hover.
Ensure logical focus order in RTL.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the RTL direction globally <html dir='rtl' lang='ar'>.
Use Tailwind RTL utilities (logical properties) where possible.
Replace existing placeholder logos with the provided Manasati logos.
Update global CSS to include Tajawal and Cairo fonts.
Redesign the marketing homepage using the Bento grid and asymmetric layouts, utilizing the Navy and Blue colors.
Do NOT alter core app logic or external integrations. Payment and domain integrations are gated/unconfigured, not mocked; retain truthful disabled states.
Use customer's existing sites functionality without overriding their individual site colors; apply the rebrand only to the platform marketing and dashboards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use creative z-index depth, layered design elements, and glass-morphism.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use Emoji characters as icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
